items.name: Metformin Hydrochloride
items.facts: Updated label for Metformin Hydrochloride (PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.). Boxed warning: WARNING: LACTIC ACIDOSIS Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias. The onset of metformin-associated lactic acidosis is often subtle, accompanied only by nonspecific symptoms such as malaise, myalgias, respiratory distress, somnolence, and abdominal pain.
